## Objective
- Finish the existing game as a complete, playable wilderness-survival experience.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Objective
- Finish the existing exploration prototype as a complete, playable wilderness-survival game.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification, make reasonable assumptions, and briefly note them on completion.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Make the game objective-based: recover three field relays, then return to the beacon.
- Include predator damage and failure, completion screens, minimap markers, desktop and touch controls, and an ambient audio toggle.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added relay and beacon geometry, objective tracking, interaction prompts, and win/lose overlays in `src/main.js`.
- Added predator and survivor-echo movement, health/stamina/noise HUD updates, minimap rendering, and reset/replay behavior.
- Added keyboard, pointer-lock, and joystick/touch controls; added a synthesized ambient audio toggle.
- Updated the loading-screen initial state, fixed the title-screen CSS gradient, and added objective, interaction, end-game, and mobile styling.

### Active
- Validate the implementation and resolve any build, runtime, or gameplay bugs.
- Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; polish visuals or mobile usability if needed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `npm run build` and fix any compile errors.
2. Launch the game and test title screen, movement, relay interactions, predator attacks, pause/resume, win/loss, and replay.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results for the user.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, world entities, controls, objectives, HUD, and game loop.
- `src/style.css`: UI styling, including objective, interaction, end-game, and mobile styles.
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and initial loading-screen state.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no build or gameplay validation has been run yet.
- `src/main.js` began as a 202-line prototype; gameplay logic has been appended.
- A potential runtime concern was identified: `leaveGame()` calls `resetGame()` before the later `const endOverlay` initialization if invoked unusually early; normal interaction should occur after module initialization.

## Objective
- Finish the exploration prototype as a complete, playable wilderness-survival game and validate the result.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification, make reasonable assumptions, and briefly note them on completion.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Make the game objective-based: recover three field relays, then return to the beacon.
- Include predator damage and failure, completion screens, minimap markers, desktop and touch controls, and an ambient audio toggle.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added gameplay objectives, interactions, predator and survivor-echo movement, HUD/minimap, keyboard and touch controls, ambient audio toggle, pause/replay behavior, and win/lose overlays.
- Updated loading/title UI and added objective, interaction, end-game, and mobile styling.
- Ran `npm install` to resolve missing dependencies; `npm run build` completed, and `node --check src/main.js` reported no syntax error.

### Active
- Fix the CSS `@import must precede all other statements` build warning in `src/style.css`.
- Run browser gameplay checks and capture/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser/gameplay validation has not yet been performed.

## Next Move
1. Move the Google Fonts `@import` in `src/style.css` ahead of `@font-face` declarations and rerun `npm run build`.
2. Launch the game and test title screen, movement, relay interactions, predator attacks, pause/resume, win/loss, and replay.
3. Save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, world entities, controls, objectives, HUD, and game loop.
- `src/style.css`: UI styling and CSS import warning.
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and initial loading-screen state.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `package-lock.json`: Updated by `npm install` to resolve dependency lock mismatch.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `src/main.js`, `src/style.css`, and `package-lock.json`.
- Initial `npm ci` failed because the lockfile was out of sync; `npm install` succeeded.
- Build output showed `@import must precede all other statements`; build nevertheless completed.
- Potential runtime concern: `leaveGame()` calls `resetGame()` before the later `const endOverlay` initialization if invoked unusually early; normal interaction should occur after module initialization.

## Objective
- Finish the exploration prototype as a complete, playable wilderness-survival game and validate the result.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification, make reasonable assumptions, and briefly note them on completion.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Make the game objective-based: recover three field relays, then return to the beacon.
- Include predator damage and failure, completion screens, minimap markers, desktop and touch controls, and an ambient audio toggle.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added objectives and interactions, predator and survivor-echo movement, HUD/minimap, keyboard and touch controls, ambient audio toggle, pause/replay behavior, and win/lose overlays.
- Updated loading/title UI and added objective, interaction, end-game, and mobile styling.
- Fixed CSS `@import` ordering in `src/style.css`; `npm run build` succeeds without that warning.
- Installed dependencies with `npm install` and installed Playwright Chromium.
- Browser smoke test confirmed title screen renders, starting the game shows the HUD and objective, keyboard movement changes coordinates, and Escape pause/resume works.

### Active
- Finish browser validation of relay recovery, predator attack/failure, win/loss and replay, and ambient sound.
- Capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- Browser sound-button click check timed out because the game overlay intercepted pointer events while pointer lock was active; retry after releasing pointer lock or use a direct interaction test.
- Full objective/end-state validation remains untested.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser checks, releasing pointer lock as needed; verify sound toggle and replay/end states.
2. Save a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.
3. Review any remaining runtime issues and summarize assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Game logic, world entities, controls, objectives, HUD, and game loop.
- `src/style.css`: UI styling and import ordering.
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and title/loading states.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `package-lock.json`: Updated by `npm install`.

- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `src/main.js`, `src/style.css`, and `package-lock.json`.

- `leaveGame()` calls `resetGame()`; its declaration is later in the module, but normal user interaction occurs after module initialization.
